title: Folder View behaves poorly when in a panel
line: A Folder View in a thick top or bottom panel now shows the folder contents instead of only a big folder icon, as it already did in side panels.
explanation: The Folder View widget sets switchWidth/switchHeight so the panel shows its full representation once it has room, but switchSize() only returned a threshold for vertical panels and 0 otherwise. With a 0 threshold the panel always keeps the compact representation in horizontal panels, so a 360 px top panel showed just a huge folder icon. The change applies the same 8 grid unit threshold to every panel; thin horizontal panels still show the icon with its popup.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: Show Folder View contents in thick horizontal panels

Folder View only switched to its full representation in thick vertical
panels, so a tall top or bottom panel showed a huge folder icon instead
of the folder contents. Apply the same size threshold to all panels.

BUG: 513610

patches.diff:
From 14039bea1c9f948eec3d5f1e6d86d448a0afc96b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:13:49 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] containments/desktop: Show Folder View contents in thick
 horizontal panels

Folder View only switched to its full representation in thick vertical
panels, so a tall top or bottom panel showed a huge folder icon instead
of the folder contents. Apply the same size threshold to all panels.

BUG: 513610
---
 containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml
index d3f413b2df..1c568dff63 100644
--- a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml
+++ b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml
@@ -39,8 +39,8 @@ ContainmentItem {
     height: inPanel ? undefined : preferredFolderSize.height // Initial size when adding to e.g. desktop.
 
     function switchSize() {
-        // Support expanding into the full representation on very thick vertical panels.
-        if (inPanel && Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical) {
+        // Support expanding into the full representation on very thick panels.
+        if (inPanel) {
             return Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 8;
         }
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Pure master: 360 px top panel with a Folder View of ~/Desktop shows only a huge folder icon
With the fix: the same panel lists the folder contents

review.text: Minimal, correct change: switchSize() now applies the same 8-gridunit threshold to horizontal panels, so a thick top/bottom panel shows the full representation, and thin panels keep the compact icon. The media show the contents listed, with no flip-flop. Only issue 1 of the report is fixed, which the notes say clearly.
